strings: In m_c's old age, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} has become more and more forgetful, sometime not even rembering what day it is. m_c has developed dementia.
m_c has been living their days in a long-past time period, r_c's efforts to remind {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that that was moons ago.
AFter m_c forgets where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} again, r_c gently explains to the clan that m_c has developed dementia.
